package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"unicode/utf16"
)

// encode matches Python json.dumps(..., ensure_ascii=True).
func encode(runes []rune) string {
	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteByte('"')
	for _, c := range runes {
		switch {
		case c == '"':
			b.WriteString(`\"`)
		case c == '\\':
			b.WriteString(`\\`)
		case c == '\n':
			b.WriteString(`\n`)
		case c == '\r':
			b.WriteString(`\r`)
		case c == '\t':
			b.WriteString(`\t`)
		case c == '\b':
			b.WriteString(`\b`)
		case c == '\f':
			b.WriteString(`\f`)
		case c >= 0x20 && c <= 0x7E:
			b.WriteRune(c)
		case c < 0x10000:
			fmt.Fprintf(&b, `\u%04x`, c)
		default:
			hi, lo := utf16.EncodeRune(c)
			fmt.Fprintf(&b, `\u%04x\u%04x`, hi, lo)
		}
	}
	b.WriteByte('"')
	return b.String()
}

func main() {
	raw, _ := io.ReadAll(os.Stdin)
	var s string
	json.Unmarshal(raw, &s)
	r := []rune(s)
	n := len(r)
	fmt.Println(encode([]rune{r[n-1], ' ', r[n-2]}))
}
